# ITU T.83 test signals

Copyright (c) ITU & ISO/IEC 1994.

These compressed streams and numeric reference files are unchanged selections
from ITU's public T.83 (11/1994) test-signal archive. The manifest identifies
every original member and SHA-256. Duplicate archive members are represented
once. The accompanying standard text is not included.

Original distribution, copyright notice and disclaimer:
<https://www.itu.int/wftp3/public/t/testsignal/SpeImage/T83/v1994_11/T83_data_files.zip>

Official catalogue:
<https://www.itu.int/ITU-T/recommendations/rec.aspx?id=2635>

Additional `.coef` files, if present, are separately identified C observations;
they are not the official DREF files. DREF/EREF values are signed big-endian
integers in zigzag order. Source samples use bytes or big-endian u16 values.
